'''Chad Reedy''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 8th (standings when the author left after round 3) at [[January 2001 Fairmont tournament]] on 27 January 2001 with [[Court Of The Vile Gangster / I Shall Enjoy Watching You Die|Court]], according to Emerson Sklar's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1672">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-27-fairmont-west-virginia-1-27-01d1672/ fairmont-west-virginia-1-27-01], DeckTech (Emerson "Sparkz" Sklar, 27 January 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-27-fairmont-west-virginia-1-27-01d1672/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
